content.text: {"label":"outage","explanation":"Payments volume is +69% with service level at 24%, while general's volume is on forecast. The excess is concentrated in upi_payment_failed (2.66x normal, about 84 extra calls in the last hour). This matches open P1 incident INC-20261010-3825 (UPI switch timeouts, opened 14:25), and the jump in volume started in the 14:15 interval. Attendance is normal (2 sick versus 2 usual). The only marketing entry is an unrelated fraud-awareness post from the morning. AHT is not consistently elevated. This is a confirmed UPI outage driving demand.","plan_name":"UPI outage containment plus payments capacity boost","rationale":"Payments has roughly 40 Erlangs of load against about 26 agents. Demand reduction comes first. A known-issue IVR message targets the UPI failure calls, and chat deflection takes 20% of status and refund enquiries. Free levers come next: cancel non-mandatory payments coaching and delay payments breaks to borrow capacity during the peak. Overtime is then offered in two consecutive blocks. At about 40% acceptance, that is roughly 8 and then 6 extra agents, at about Rs 10,080 if all accepted agents work the full 2 h, within the Rs 15,000 budget. Callback is not used because the outage message already occupies the payments IVR and callbacks would only push work into the evening.
